string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: TV: the same channel in 4K, Full HD, HD and SD is now a single channel; the TV picks the quality by itself and steps down if the picture stalls (Options › Quality to choose by hand)
TV: leaner left menu; All and Guide sit next to LISTS and Radio left (it is in Listen)
TV: New category with the channels added to the list in the last 14 days
TV: when a channel does not open, the TV tells you if the list expired or another screen is using it
Ambient mode: after 2 minutes idle on the home screen, the cross steps back and only the art and a big clock stay; any key brings you back where you were
The art behind the cross glides a little as you move, adding depth
Glass top bar: a single translucent strip with profile, search, weather and time (the other bars are still in Settings › Home screen)
At night, “Sleep in 30 min” appears at the end of Continue: the screen dims slowly and the TV turns off; OK again cancels
With two or more profiles, the TV asks “Who’s watching?” when it turns on after sleeping
Each new feature has its own switch in Settings › Home screen

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: In the TV list, do more categories fit, with All and Guide next to LISTS and no Radio?
Does a channel that used to repeat (4K, FHD, HD) show only once, and does ▶ ▶ › Quality show the choices?
Leaving the home screen idle for 2 minutes, does the cross disappear and a big clock stay? Does one key bring everything back?
Does the top bar show as a glass strip, with the time on the right?
After 10 pm, in Continue, does “Sleep in 30 min” set the timer and show “Turns off at…”?
